summary:
FIX-CHEF-MIDFLOW-BAIL-DETERMINISM (P1, recurring, recurrence_count=2) — PLAN-ONLY spec ready per the row's own AC. Two-layer determinism guard: Layer 1 (chef-telemetry.md new '§ Degraded-Floor Recovery' section + widened chef.md Step-1 floor trigger + one-line checkpoint pointers after every chef-dish.md step 1.5/2/3/4/5/6/6.5/6.7 + Try/Catch Boundary start pinned to Step 0.5) makes the degraded-floor publish reachable from ANY partial state, not just the 'scope clarification' branch the first 2 occurrences hit — closes AC(a) and the 2026-07-29 corroboration's widening demand (token-budget wall mid-Layer-analysis, same defect class, different trigger). Layer 2 (system-auditor published-marker orphan sweep, same pattern family as its existing Step-0b.1 stale-marker check) is the actual code-enforced guarantee for AC(b), since Layer 1 is still agent-followed prose and 3 real occurrences (incl. one that already carried the pre-existing hard 'no third path between SENT and FAILED' rule) prove prose alone is insufficient here — flagged as FOLLOW-UP-2, separate row, does not block FOLLOW-UP-1. Both layers' release-call branches CALL INTO (never duplicate) UC-CCA-P3's Published Marker Release Gate (docs/architecture-briefs/2026-08-06-cowork-marker-lifecycle-anchor-and-release.md Component B) — confirmed live via grep this cycle that ZERO code paths call task_release on a published:* key today anywhere in this repo; until that gate ships, the interim behavior is explicitly 'do not release, leave for TTL self-heal' (already today's documented safe practice, never a raw ungated release). Brief §6 gives the full FOLLOW-UP-1/FOLLOW-UP-2 file-by-file decomposition and §7 a verification gate.

BOARD-ROW ACTION REQUESTED (agents-architect has no orch-state.json write authority per commit-boundary SKILL.md zone table — routing this through the standard brief_complete signal for po/dev-team to action, same as every prior agents-architect brief): move FIX-CHEF-MIDFLOW-BAIL-DETERMINISM from task_board.backlog[] to task_board.review[] (lane-coherence requires status=REVIEW to live in review[]), set status="REVIEW", keep priority=P1, keep supervised:true (rationale unchanged — still blocks BOUNDED-1 idle-auto-launch of this maintenance-lane row per UC-ASL-P6; unaffected by this spec), keep next_agent="agent-father" (FOLLOW-UP-1 implementer), add field architect_spec_ref="docs/architecture-briefs/2026-08-07-chef-midflow-bail-determinism-guard.md" (do NOT overwrite the existing detail_ref, which still points at the 2026-07-17 handoff — additive only), and append a status_note: "PLAN-ONLY spec authored 2026-08-07 by agents-architect (docs/architecture-briefs/2026-08-07-chef-midflow-bail-determinism-guard.md). Implementation is a FOLLOW-UP task, NOT done here — awaiting po/architect sign-off before dev-team decomposes FOLLOW-UP-1 (agent-father, chef.md/chef-dish.md/chef-telemetry.md) and FOLLOW-UP-2 (agent-father, system-auditor orphan sweep, separate row)."
